mapper.select: SELECT report_no, policy_number, accident_at, accident_description, damage_details, accident_type, accident_status, accident_report_document_name, medical_certificate_file_name, claim_document_name, created_at FROM accident_report WHERE report_no = #{accidentNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO damage_investigation ( investigation_id, report_no, adjuster_id, investigation_at, medical_expense, lost_income, repair_cost, settlement_amount, fault_ratio, created_at ) VALUES ( #{investigationId}, #{request.accidentNumber}, #{request.adjusterId}, #{request.investigationAt}, #{request.medicalExpense}, #{request.lostIncome}, #{request.repairCost}, #{request.settlementAmount}, #{request.faultRatio}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO payment_approval_document ( document_id, report_no, investigation_id, document_type, submission_status, damage_amount, fault_ratio, created_at ) VALUES ( #{documentId}, #{accidentNumber}, #{investigationId}, #{documentType}, #{submissionStatus}, #{totalDamageAmount}, #{faultRatio}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_approval_document SET fault_ratio_opinion = #{faultRatioOpinion}, adjuster_opinion = #{adjusterOpinion}, submission_status = #{submissionStatus} WHERE document_id = ( SELECT document_id FROM payment_approval_document WHERE report_no = #{accidentNumber} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 )

UPDATE payment_approval_document SET employee_no = #{employeeNo}, submission_status = #{submissionStatus}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt} WHERE document_id = ( SELECT document_id FROM payment_approval_document WHERE report_no = #{accidentNumber} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT pad.document_id, pad.report_no, pad.investigation_id, pad.document_type, pad.submission_status, pad.damage_amount, pad.fault_ratio, ROUND((pad.damage_amount * pad.fault_ratio::numeric / 100), 2) AS calculated_payment_amount, pad.fault_ratio_opinion, pad.adjuster_opinion, pad.employee_no, ar.accident_status, pad.created_at, pad.submitted_at FROM payment_approval_document pad JOIN accident_report ar ON ar.report_no = pad.report_no WHERE pad.report_no = #{accidentNumber} ORDER BY pad.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT di.investigation_id, di.report_no, di.adjuster_id, di.investigation_at, di.medical_expense, di.lost_income, di.repair_cost, di.settlement_amount, di.fault_ratio, COALESCE( pad.damage_amount, di.medical_expense + di.lost_income + di.repair_cost + di.settlement_amount ) AS total_damage_amount, ROUND(( COALESCE( pad.damage_amount, di.medical_expense + di.lost_income + di.repair_cost + di.settlement_amount ) * di.fault_ratio::numeric / 100 ), 2) AS calculated_payment_amount, pad.document_id, pad.document_type, pad.submission_status, pad.fault_ratio_opinion, pad.adjuster_opinion, pad.employee_no, ar.accident_status, COALESCE(pad.created_at, di.created_at) AS created_at, pad.submitted_at FROM damage_investigation di JOIN accident_report ar ON ar.report_no = di.report_no LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT document_id, document_type, submission_status, damage_amount, fault_ratio_opinion, adjuster_opinion, employee_no, created_at, submitted_at FROM payment_approval_document WHERE report_no = di.report_no ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) pad ON true WHERE di.report_no = #{accidentNumber} ORDER BY di.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
